_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Parts List
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for a Parts List that provides detailed parts information to support the provisioning process, identifying maintenance part support requirements to the Lowest Replaceable Unit level.
use_relationship:
The Part List is required in support of the provisioning process and includes detailed parts information on each separate item of equipment. The required information will be sufficient enough to identify maintenance part support requirements for the field to the Lowest Replaceable Unit (LRU) level (unless specified otherwise as piece part or box level).

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the Parts List resulting from the work task described in paragraphs 3.2.7 through 3.2.8.4 of DOD-M-86001(NS).

This DID is applicable to the acquisition of Non Developmental Item (NDI) i.e.,Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) equipment.

This DID supersedes DI-ILSS-81359A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation; for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

preparation_instructions.title: Format/Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Spare Parts List shall include the following data in accordance with paragraphs 3.2.7 through 3.2.8.4 of DOD-M-86001(NS).

preparation_instructions.title: Parts List
preparation_instructions.content: The parts list shall include all maintenance significant parts in the equipment which can be replaced and repaired in the field by maintenance personnel utilizing the LRU concept. Each assembly shall be broken down in top-down order with the part number proceeding the listing. For example, list an assembly by part number first then all of the printed circuit cards and modules by part number which comprise the assembly as described in the following:

children.title: List all parts which may require repair
children.content: List all parts which may require repair or procurement during the life of the equipment.

children.title: Do not list hardware items such as attaching parts
children.content: Do not list hardware items such as attaching parts, chassis, or frames, nor items normally supplied in bulk (wire, tubing, etc.) unless they are special type or critical dimension.

children.title: Arrange the list in reference designator order
children.content: Arrange the list in reference designator order.

children.title: Start with top assembly (equipment) then break down
children.content: Start with top assembly (equipment) then break down each assembly (A1, A2, etc) followed by replaceable chassis mounted components.

children.title: Provide sufficient information of each item to
children.content: Provide sufficient information of each item to permit its acquisition for the manufacturer identified by CAGE code or from a similarly identified commercial source.

children.title: The parts list shall contain the following information
children.content: The parts list shall contain the following information in the same order listed name.

children.title: The true manufacturer model and part number
children.content: The true manufacturer model and part number designated for each item. System designers or end item manufacturers part numbers may be used as acceptable true manufacturers numbers only for those items altered specifically for use in the item.

children.title: A description of each part
children.content: The identifying noun or item name

children.title: The reference designation of each part listed
The true manufacturers CAGE code for each part
children.content: The true manufacturers CAGE code for each part (in lieu of the manufacturers noun name).

children.title: The quantity of each part in the equipment/unit
The unit cost of each part at the
children.content: The unit cost of each part at the time parts list is prepared.

children.title: Recommended quantity to sustain operation for the
children.content: Recommended quantity to sustain operation for the time period and under the conditions stated in the contract.
